title: Deterministic layout
text: A seeded force simulation that settles and stops; reduced motion skips the animation.

title: Neighbor navigation
text: Arrow keys move to the connected node in that direction; neighbors light up on focus.

title: Pin by drag or key
text: Drag a node or press Shift with an arrow key to pin it; U unpins.

title: Adjacency table
text: Every connection, with weights, in an accessible table.
